question: If graph-disabled summed GPU compute is approximately equal on gfx1100 and gfx1201, where does the additional gfx1201 graph-enabled served-request time actually go?
scope_rule: No optimization work and no EXP number during LEAD-0005. An experiment may be frozen only after this investigation identifies a mechanism and a falsifiable intervention.
primary_condition: same graph-enabled production request on each isolated GPU
request_scope: Each measured stream is delimited after two warmups; initialization and teardown are excluded.

definitions.T_GPU_busy: union of request-clipped kernel and device-copy intervals
definitions.T_GPU_idle: T_request minus T_GPU_busy; also report idle within first-to-last GPU submission
definitions.T_HIP_API: union and inclusive duration of request-clipped HIP runtime calls
definitions.T_graph_create_update_launch: separate union durations and call counts for create/instantiate, update, and launch
definitions.T_memcpy: device-copy interval union; separately report HIP memcpy API duration, direction counts, and H2D/D2H bytes
definitions.T_CPU_frontend_and_decode: request-scoped timestamp spans, not duration-only counters
definitions.T_other: unclaimed request wall time after mutually exclusive interval attribution
definitions.inter_kernel_gap: positive gap between adjacent merged request-clipped kernel intervals
definitions.CPU_blocked_waiting_fraction: union of request-clipped host synchronize/wait spans divided by T_request

reconciliation: For every request, T_request = mutually exclusive attributable execution time + T_other + residual. Residual must be <= max(1 ms, 0.5% of T_request), and all overlapping inclusive metrics must remain diagnostic rather than additive.
admissibility_gate: Instrumentation must preserve the direction of the uninstrumented graph-enabled cross-target result and stay within 5% latency per target, or its affected buckets are inadmissible for causal attribution.
causal_output_gate: Conclude with a named +X ms/request mechanism only when it is stable across requests, reconciles, survives the observer-effect gate, and explains at least 50% of the cross-target residual. Otherwise HOLD and refine measurement.
